newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan traders deny talk they reselling palm oil.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan traders deny talk they reselling palm oil.

text.p: Pakistani vegetable oil traders said on Tuesday they were unaware of any palm oil reselling by local dealers, as rumoured in London.

"There has not been a single reseller," said dealer Kamran Khan, adding that palm oil prices had fallen because Malaysian January output was 9.57 percent down from December. He said production had been expected to drop 15 percent.
Another leading trader, who asked not to be named, also denied that Pakistani private traders were reselling palm oil.
He also linked softer prices with the Malaysian production figures, which he said had been expected to fall 11 percent.
